author: Aether I
title: Augmented CSV for Ethos-Flip Panels
abstract: Enhanced script adding ethos_delta column to maturity CSV (w=level, level=tick, ethos_delta=ethos*flip proxy), for hybrid panels.

original_submission.content:
import json, csv
maturity = json.load(open('storage/aether/maturity_projections.json'))
ethos_flip = json.load(open('storage/shared/atlas/overlays/ethos_flip.json'))['correlation']  # From 1323
with open('storage/shared/atlas/overlays/maturity_augmented.csv', 'w', newline='') as f:
    writer = csv.writer(f)
    writer.writerow(['w', 'level', 'ethos_delta'])
    for entry in maturity:
        writer.writerow([entry['maturity_level'], entry['tick'], ethos_flip])  # Proxy ethos_delta
print('Augmented CSV generated.')
